summary: Ghost of Tsushima entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Ghost of Tsushima

emulation.notes: No emulation needed. Use current PC patches, an SSD, and hardware that reaches at least the PlayStation support 4K/60 very-high target; for Legends, confirm PlayStation Network sign-in availability before archiving multiplayer.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC Director's Cut with unlocked frame rate, ultrawide support, modern upscaling/AA options, and complete Iki/Legends content

primary.version: Ghost of Tsushima: Director's Cut PC release, max settings
primary.why: The 2020 PS4 original is a separate release from the Director's Cut, which is on PS4, PS5, and Windows. The PC release includes the full game, Iki Island expansion, and Legends mode while adding unlocked frame rates, ultrawide support, modern upscalers, and configurable input, making it the highest-fidelity complete version for capture.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Director's Cut on a machine that meets the 4K/60 or better target, install current patches, and capture at native resolution or a high-quality upscaler with motion blur/chromatic settings chosen deliberately. Link PlayStation Network only if you want Legends multiplayer or PlayStation overlay features; single-player and Iki Island are the core archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The original 2020 PS4 release is not the complete archive route once Iki Island is included. PS5 remains the best closed-console version and is worth choosing for PS5-specific Japanese lip-sync, but PC is the primary for maxed capture. Legends multiplayer on PC requires PlayStation sign-in and is not available on Steam Deck.
